summary: IMS Manual Builder — full backend + frontend regression PASS. Backend 11/11 pytest cases pass covering GET/PUT manual, section CRUD, edit revision bump + Draft reset + snapshot, section approve, revisions history, whole-manual approve, section PDF, full manual PDF, and unauthenticated 403. Frontend e2e (localhost:3000): login → /ims/manual loads with 29 sections, TOC grouped Manual/Procedures, click loads content, add custom section (TEST-UI-1), edit content + change-summary + clause mapping chip appears then saves (heading updates, badge back to Draft), approve-section-btn flips to Approved, revision history dialog renders entries, print-section-btn AND print-manual-btn trigger PDF downloads (Section_TEST-UI-1.pdf and IMS-Manual.pdf), edit-manual-meta-btn saves doc_number and updates header, archive-section-btn removes the custom section from TOC. Regression: Standards Library and Menu Configuration pages load correctly. No blocking issues found. Note: after backend tests approved the whole manual (per plan) the seeded 29 sections are all Approved — this matches the review note.

issues: 'Approve Manual' button remains enabled and prominently green even when manual is already fully Approved — consider disabling or graying out to indicate no-op state.

critical_code_review_comments: ims_manual_routes.approve_manual: new_rev logic bumps revision only when manual was already approved before — first approval keeps rev at 1, which is probably intentional but easy to misread. Consider adding a comment.
IMSManual.js: downloadBlob uses api.get with responseType=blob but does not catch errors — a 500 on the PDF endpoint would silently fail with no toast. Wrap in try/catch and toast on error.
IMSManual.js: no confirmation on 'Approve Manual' beyond a window.confirm — consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app.
ims_manual_routes.update_section: bumps revision even when payload content is identical to current — consider skipping snapshot when nothing meaningful changed to avoid noise in revisions.
PDF download does not stream progress — a 44-page export could be several MB; blob approach is fine but a loading toast would improve UX.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and archived a custom section (TEST-99). Frontend test created and archived TEST-UI-1. Meta doc_number was set to 'IMS-MAN-001-TEST' via UI test (unchanged from previous value pattern). All 29 seeded sections are now Approved (result of the manual-approve regression test — expected per review note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend passing at 100%. All 29 sections currently Approved after test_approve_whole_manual — if a subsequent test needs Draft sections, edit any section (which resets it and the manual back to Draft) or re-seed. Frontend uses http://localhost:3000 (external URL is iframed) — login inputs use #username/#password. PDF downloads work via authenticated axios blob; ensure Playwright expect_download for print buttons.
